purpose: Review city-local registry basis and anonymous geometry-only routes without querying personal/property attributes.
primaryPublisher: Belagavi City Corporation; Belagavi District Administration, Government of Karnataka
registryBasis: Belagavi City Corporation’s application-procedure page requires a CTS extract and map for a trade-licence application, and references a Form III property-tax register extract for building licensing. The Belagavi District Administration separately identifies a Land Records office at the DC Office and links Karnataka’s RTC service. This is city-local survey/record-service evidence; it does not establish an anonymous vector service or a public full-polygon schema.

officialSources.observation: The municipal procedure page lists a CTS extract and map among trade-licence attachments and a Form III property-tax register extract for building licensing. These are local cadastral/municipal record documents, not an open geometry endpoint.

Belagavi District Administration describes online Pahani/RTC land-record service and gives the District Land Records office location as the DC Office, Belagavi. RTC is a record service; the page does not provide urban parcel vectors.
Kannada-language Belagavi District land-record service page points to the same RTC/Pahani service and local Land Records office.
